description: Defines the GuarantorData class used for representing guarantor information in the loan account module of the Fineract project, including fields for guarantor details, methods for creating and merging guarantor instances, and utility methods for guarantor type checks.

classes.name: GuarantorData
classes.description: Data class representing guarantor information, including personal details, guarantor type, relationship, funding details, and utility methods for creating, merging, and type checking.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a GuarantorData instance from import parameters.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template GuarantorData with default options.

methods.name: templateOnTop
methods.description: Creates a GuarantorData based on an existing one, overlaying options.

methods.name: mergeClientData
methods.description: Merges ClientData into GuarantorData, updating guarantor info with client details.

methods.name: mergeStaffData
methods.description: Merges StaffData into GuarantorData, updating guarantor info with staff details.

methods.name: isExternalGuarantor
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is external.

methods.name: isExistingClient
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is an existing client.

methods.name: isStaffMember
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor is a staff member.
